prompt: According to the test card, when would a display fault be worth checking?
promptZh: 依測試卡，何時才值得檢查螢幕是否故障？

options.text: When a streak vanishes as soon as one source is covered
options.zh: 遮住某個光源後，亮紋立刻消失時
options.whyZh: 這個結果指向反射，不是檢查螢幕故障的條件。

options.text: When a streak appears only when seen from the counter
options.zh: 只有從櫃檯看才有亮紋時
options.whyZh: 指南還要求從螢幕旁也看得到。

options.text: When the streak remains in every cover test and is visible both from the counter and beside the screen
options.zh: 亮紋在每次遮蔽測試中仍在，且從櫃檯和螢幕旁都看得到時
options.whyZh: 保留所有遮蔽都無效及近旁亦可見兩條件。

options.text: When the samples look dark with the shade down
options.zh: 放下捲簾時樣品看起來很暗時
options.whyZh: 樣品亮度不是螢幕故障的判斷標準。

explanationZh: 保留所有遮蔽都無效及近旁亦可見兩條件。
evidence: If a streak stays visible through all cover tests and can be seen from beside the screen as well, check for a fault in the display.

vocabulary.note: 此處指螢幕本身的異常。

difficultyRationale: 兩個條件需同時滿足，而非僅在櫃檯出現。
